description:
Find a published community strategy that matches a plain-English idea.

    Mirrors the quantifyme.ai landing page: "Found <X> by @<author> (WR/PF):
    use it, or generate fresh". It is for browsing; a vague deploy request is
    handled by one_shot(prompt=...) alone, which deploys the best curated preset
    or a fresh build. A community strategy is another user's code, so it deploys
    only after the user has seen its author and code (get_strategy_code with the
    match's community_id) and picked it. The two outcomes:
      - use the match: one_shot(community_id=<match.community_id>) deploys that
        exact strategy, with no generation;
      - generate fresh: one_shot(prompt="<their description>") writes a new
        custom strategy.
    With no match, only the second applies.

    Args:
      description: the user's strategy idea in plain English (e.g. "buy EURUSD
        15min when RSI < 30, sell when RSI > 70").
      symbol: optional pair to constrain the match (EURUSD, USDJPY, GBPUSD,
        USDCHF, USDCAD, AUDUSD, NZDUSD).
      timeframe: optional granularity to constrain the match (1min/5min/15min/1h).

    Returns:
      dict with:
        - match: the best existing strategy, or null. When present:
            {community_id, title, username, wr, pf, ret, n_trades, symbol,
             timeframe}. Pass community_id to one_shot to deploy it unchanged.
        - description: echoed back; one_shot(prompt=...) with it generates fresh.
        - suggestion: one sentence describing the match and the two outcomes.
name: find_strategy
title: Find a Matching Strategy
